headline: Drake @champagnepapi confirms that multiple tracks from his “FOMO” short film are dropping
body: Drake @champagnepapi confirms that multiple tracks from his “FOMO” short film are dropping on streaming services this Thursday “All the songs you guys have been asking for... well, not all of them, but enough of them, are coming on Thursday. ”.
